examples.en: The physical benefits of chiropractic are similar to those of yoga.
examples.zh: 脊神经疗法对身体的益处与瑜伽相似。

examples.en: So, if you have subluxations, you could be a good candidate for chiropractic care.
examples.zh: 如果您有一些脊椎半脱位的情形，最好趁早做好脊椎保健。

examples.en: A permanent cure will only be effected by acupuncture, chiropractic or manipulation.
examples.zh: 只有针灸、脊椎指压治疗或者推拿术才能实现彻底治愈。
